extraction.Name: Edward Beauvais
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I sold it because the crops were poor and I had to pay the taxes.
extraction.NOTES: Did not request the patent. Sold land for $15.00 an acre - $2400.00 Cash. Had paid all taxes; no mortgage on it. Sold because crops didn't grow and was afraid he would lose it. Satisfied with the sale. Has a 12 year old daughter in school and his mother as dependents. Not married. Document number N04086. 460. Superintendent E. E. McKean referenced.
